claim.statement: The perception → entropy step (step 1 of M.49's 9-step pipeline) is localised in takwin.py:33174-33270 as the _geoid_entropy method. Per-concept entropy is computed from GeoidGraph edge weights via the geometric mean of (a) Shannon entropy of the normalised edge-weight distribution and (b) edge-weight contrast = 1 - (w_max - w_min)/w_max. This closes the reasoning pipeline end-to-end mechanically: every link from raw text input to Walker halt is now code-cited.

Verify the output is used at takwin.py:18089 to set _prior_entropy_profile (the input to next-cycle entropy_proxy).
